notes.title: The Character Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the Character Update!
 - We added an entirely new Character System for the game, buy, customize, edit and play with different characters.
 - Wheelie Rewards: Get rewards for performing tricks and wheelies in the Free Mode
 - Power Ups available to buy: Double Cash and Double XP so you can make EVEN MORE Cash as you play!

 - New Bikes: The Mete 03 and the Racer 300
 - Redesigned In App Store with New Stuff!
 - New Characters: The Menino, Mandraka,  the Hothead and the Cop

notes.title: The Boss Battle Update
notes.content:
- A Brand New Street Time Trial Map!
Face off against the Ruler of the Street Time Trials in a challenging race to win a brand new Bike!

Unlock this race by beating time trial maps on the Street category!

 - New Cutscenes added to the Time Trial game mode

 - The 3x6 and the Tersol are no longer on Sale
 - NEW BIKE ON SALE! The Pop 1000 and the 125 Coffee are on Sale! Get them while they are cheap!

notes.title: Balancing Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the Physics Update!

We have updated and changed the physics of ALL motorcycles to make the gameplay experience smoother.
Additionally, we have made graphic and performance improvements for all mobile devices.

notes.title: 1.3.060 Patch!
notes.content:
Hello players! Thank you so much for your support!

We fixed and redid our backend so that players coming from the Mobile game can now migrate their saves correctly!

Please, update the game on your mobile devices before logging in to this new update! Thanks!

- Devora
